$comment: Single source for the entry tag vocabulary (issue #138). Read by scripts/build-readme.py, which also regenerates the vocabulary table in CONTRIBUTING.md between its tags markers. Add a value here, nowhere else.

agent.$comment: `opencode` was here until 2026-09-22. It entered the vocabulary from a misread: a scan took "OpenCode Zen's free tier" in the jev-agent-skill description for the OpenCode coding agent, but that is the LLM gateway the project routes through. That entry has always been tagged claude-code, and no entry ever used an opencode tag. Add it back when a real OpenCode project appears (see issue #154).
agent.description: The coding agent an entry targets. Colours are anchored on the vendor's brand colour where there is one, then darkened until white badge text clears WCAG AA; the raw brand colours do not (Anthropic clay #D97757 carries white text at 2.9:1).

multi.label: Multi
multi.definition: Explicitly supports several coding agents, or is built to be agent-agnostic. Not merely a library that any agent could call.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.definition: Targets Anthropic's Claude Code. Not the Claude models in general, which many entries call without targeting the agent.

pi.label: Pi
pi.definition: Targets the Pi coding agent. A name beginning with pi- is not on its own evidence, and neither is the word pi in prose.

codex.label: Codex
codex.definition: Targets OpenAI's Codex. Not a codex in the ordinary sense of a rulebook or reference document.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.definition: Targets the Cursor editor. Not the database or text cursor of the same name.

dsh.label: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.definition: Targets DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Not DeepSeek models in general, which many entries call without targeting its harness.

openclaw.label: OpenClaw
openclaw.definition: Targets the OpenClaw agent through its plugin, hook or skill API. Not projects that merely have claw in their name.

type.description: How the project is consumed. The whole axis shares one neutral grey: only the agent axis carries hue, so 'which agent' stays scannable and a two-badge entry does not read as two equal claims.

api.definition: Exposes an API other programs call over the network. A library with a public interface is a library.

proxy.definition: Sits between a client and a model endpoint, serving requests. A library that merely picks a model is not a proxy.

plugin.definition: An add-on to a coding agent. Not a browser add-on, which is `extension`.

hosted.definition: Runs as a service someone else operates.

self-hosted.definition: Runs as a service you operate yourself.

extension.definition: An add-on to a browser. Not an add-on to a coding agent, which is `plugin`, and not an editor extension whose only role is to host an agent.
